remarks: Turnkey - Beautiful Cape. Bright and modern remodeled in today's taste 4 bedroom. Completely renovated top to bottom! New Kitchen cabinets, quartz countertops, new stainless steel appliances. The side door leads to a large deck - perfect for barbecues and gatherings. Original stained hardwood floors, 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full modern baths. Walk-out finished lower level ideal for playroom, office or just extra living space! House was completely freshly painted inside and out. Updated roof, gutters, new windows, new C/A system, Energy efficient New boiler, water heater tank and electrical panel 200 amp. Easy access to Merritt Parkway, I-95 and Route 7. House is equipped with a zone system with 3 zones - one on each level (fist floor, second floor and basement)
